lines.zh: 三叠纪的猎手走得很轻
lines.en: A Triassic hunter walks lightly.
On my toes, heels never touching earth.
Head low, hugging the rock wall.
The plains wind carries a scent.
My tail stretches straight behind me.
Skirting the shrubs, avoiding open ground.
Each step tests before it lands.
My pace is half a beat faster than yours.
Scattered stones roll from under my feet.
Old Argentine hunting grounds. I know them.

lines.zh: 身体略微前倾，随时能冲
lines.en: Leaning forward, ready to dash.

lines.zh: 从阴影走到另一片阴影
lines.en: From one patch of shade to the next.
Claws tucked, making no sound.
Nose down, I loop halfway around.
Light-boned and steady on the run.
Tracks spotted. I change course.
My teeth grind softly in my throat.
Even leaving, I keep looking back.
Still as a dead stump.
Opening my jaws to flex them.
My gaze sweeps the whole plain.
I don't call. I only breathe.

lines.zh: 爪子在地面留下三道痕
lines.en: Three claw lines scored in the dirt.
Head cocked to the rustle in the grass.
Resting my tail on a flat stone.
The air cools. I don't care for it.
Slow blinks, one eye at a time.
I let the small ones pass first.
Two chews, and it's all grit.
I roll my neck and it cracks.
From high ground I see farther.

lines.zh: 树影移了，我也换了位置
lines.en: The shade moved, so I moved too.
Eyes fixed on your stretch of horizon.
I'm not moving yet. Let it wait.
You're slower than I expected.
No rush. Let me look at you.
My nostrils flare, then relax.
One eye, from the side, is enough.
What is that stick in your hand?
I lower my head a fraction.

lines.zh: 这一步不是威胁，是试探
lines.en: This step is a test, not a threat.
Back away and I won't follow.

lines.zh: 你的影子落进了我的地界
lines.en: Your shadow fell on my ground.
Last meal is still between my teeth.
Head tilted, weighing how heavy you are.
Watching you. Still watching.
It hurts, but I won't cry out.
I draw back, eyes fixed on you.
Blood runs down past my teeth.
I'll hold onto this grudge.
A dull ache sits in my ribs.
Retreating, growling all the way.

lines.zh: 同伴不来，我只能自己扛
lines.en: No pack to help. I bear it alone.
I shake my head and blood flies.
You're tougher than I guessed.
My legs still work, so I can still run.
Meat. I smell meat.
Is that for me?
Approaching slow, so you don't spook.
Raw meat. The bloodier the better.
Hunger makes my teeth itch.
Set it down, then step back.

lines.zh: 我的头压低到你的腰间
lines.en: My head drops level with your waist.
This won't even fill a tooth gap.
If you twitch, I pounce.
I'll eat it. Then I might eat you.
That bloody smell keeps getting stronger.
No sound, I just edge forward.
First I circle once around you.
Steady hands. I can smell nerves.
That meat buys you one path out.
When it's gone, I'll want something else.
You struck my shoulder.
I spin to face you instantly.
Keep off the tip of my tail.
I'm counting that as a strike.
I dodge sideways, then step back in.
Hard bones. That bump cost you.
Give me room. Don't walk so close.
My growl rattles with a rasp.
Try that one more time.
The spot you hit still burns.
My tail curls over and around hers.
Scraping a shallow nest in the soil.
She looks first. Then I dare approach.
My snout brushes her lower jaw.
A call so low only she hears it.
We take turns guarding the nest.
We chase down small prey together.
She moves fast. I keep close.

lines.zh: 两条尾巴在草丛里相碰
lines.en: Two tails meet in the grass.
This range will be ours.
I snatch it up and turn away.
One bite first, to test it.
Small thing. Swallowed whole.
Dragging it behind a rock.
Eating while scanning around me.
That leg is mine.
Held in my jaws, it smells right.
The rest I hide under dry leaves.
Don't watch. My manners are poor.
Done. I lick my teeth clean.
The moment you turned, I moved.
The scent finally matches.
No warning. I simply start moving.
My eyes lock onto your knees.
There's no cover on this plain.
That sound you heard was me.
I quicken, but I'm not running yet.
First I'll herd you into the open.
Tail high, coiling strength.

lines.zh: 三叠纪的鼻子，一闻就知道。
lines.en: A Triassic nose knows blood at once.
Shadowing you. No hurry to strike.
You change direction. So do I.
The distance shortens bit by bit.
I slip into your blind side.

lines.zh: 爪印离你的脚印更近了
lines.en: My prints close in on yours.
You look back, I stop dead.
I know this ground better than you run it.
My lungs are still full. Are yours?
Waiting for you to reach that boulder.
One more step and you're in my range.
My teeth slice in from the side.
My foreclaws pin your shadow down.
Low charge into your ribs.

lines.zh: 咬完就退，你不容易打中
lines.en: Bite and retreat. Hard to hit me.
That bite caught armor instead.
My tail whips across your leg.
I leap and land behind you.
My jaws snap shut with a clack.
Good block. What about the next one?

lines.zh: 喉咙里的声音一直没停
lines.en: The rasp in my throat never stops.
I step out from a rock crevice.
Soil still clings to my claw tips.
Triassic air. I know this.
Crouch first, then look around.
Shaking the dust off my tail.
The plain is strangely quiet.
Something moves in the distance.
I set off along the wind.
My first breath goes deep.
From nothing, my tracks begin.
I stand tall and stretch my neck.
I claim this hunting ground again.
Flame roasts the side of my belly.
My knees give out on landing.
Underwater, my jaws open too wide.
The blast throws me into the brush.
An arrow punches through my tail.
Something is wrong, and I can't name it.
Hunger makes even my bones feel light.
Lightning bleaches my sight white.
Nothing below me. I'm falling.
